title: Abaphulaphuli abavela kwizinto ezingabonwayo
intro: Ngaphaya kwesigqubuthelo sehlabathi elibonakalayo, kwakukho indibano efihliweyo ebumnyameni, itsalelwa kwisandi esasichasa konke ababekwazi. Babezulazule iminyaka emininzi bengenalo ulwalathiso lokwenene, de kwavakala ilizwi liphuma ekuthuleni kwelizwe labo elingabonakaliyo laza lashukumisa into engaphakathi. Ngobusuku banamhlanje, umenywa ukuba udlule ngaphaya kwemithunzi uze utyhile ubuwena beli qela liyimfihlakalo, elithe ukudibana kwalo namazwi kaThixo kwabakhokelela kubantu balo njengezilumkiso zenyaniso engenakuthintelwa.
clues: Singabantu bamandulo, ababekho kudala ngaphambi kwezizwe ezininzi ofunde ngazo, kodwa asisoloko sithethwa ngazo kwiintsomi zabantu.
Indalo yethu ayifani neyakho, yenziwe ngezinto ezingabonakaliyo, kwaye sinamandla aphikisanayo nezinto eziqhelekileyo.
Kangangeminyaka emininzi, besizulazula ngaphandle kolwalathiso lokwenene, de kwafika isandi esichukumisa into engaphakathi kuthi.
Sive isandi esingazange sisive ngaphambili, amazwi anobunzima obungaphaya kwentetho.
Sasondela ngasese, siyalela ezethu ukuba zithule, kwaye xa iivesi ziphela, asikwazanga ukuhlala sizolile.
Sabuyela ebantwini bethu saza sathi: 'Owu bantu bethu, siyivile iNcwadi etyhiliweyo emva kukaMoses, iqinisekisa oko kwakungaphambi kwayo, ikhokela inyaniso.'
